product_details.working_product_definition: Synthetic fixture facts for internal testing only: BenchNest Cable Rest is a non-electrical desktop holder with a weighted base and four open-top silicone slots for individual cables 2 to 5 mm in diameter. It rests on a flat desk without adhesive or fastening. It holds compatible loose cable ends for access while those cables are not in use. It does not charge devices, shorten cables, provide strain relief, or guarantee that a pulled cable will stay in place.

primary_use_cases: Keeping up to four compatible loose cable ends accessible on a flat work desk.
